_source: Server-side battle exp rates, in no client table or Lua. Wiki-derived (wiki.biligame.com/blhx 战斗评分 and 升级经验, read through a summarising fetch; azurlane.koumakan.jp Morale through a search summary) and checked against the official capture (.cache/captures/official-avrora-*: two S-rank 3-ship campaign battles, commander exp 65, happy-morale ship exp = expedition exp x 1.2 x 2 x 1.2). Scores are ys.Battle.BattleConst.BattleScore letters (D 0, C 1, B 2, A 3, S 4).

ship_rank_rates._source: BWIKI 战斗评分: A is the base, S x1.2, A x1.0, B x0.8, C or D x0.1

ship_energy_rates._source: by energy_template id, others x1. 4 (121-150, 'EXP bonus' in energy_desc_4): x1.2, the capture's rate; 1 (morale 0): halved, koumakan Morale page

player_exp._source: BWIKI 升级经验: commander exp depends only on the commander - enemy level gap, the ships sortied and the rank. by_ships: A rank, gap <= 20, x1 row (2-9 ships; the page lists no 1-ship value); S = A x1.2, B = S x2/3; gap 21-40 x0.6 and gap >= 41 x0.12 of the A row whatever the rank; the page has no C/D value
